brief: 5 mistakes killing your personal brand — and what to do instead.

slots.title: Posting without a clear strategy
slots.body: Random content confuses your audience and dilutes your message. A clear strategy builds trust and authority over time.

slots.title: Trying to appeal to everyone
slots.body: When you speak to everyone, you resonate with no one. Define your ideal audience and create content specifically for them.

slots.title: Using inconsistent visuals across platforms
slots.body: Mismatched colors and fonts make you look amateur. Consistent visuals signal professionalism and build instant recognition.

slots.title: Ignoring community and all engagement
slots.body: Broadcasting without interaction feels impersonal. Reply to comments and messages to turn followers into loyal advocates.

slots.title: Copying others instead of being authentic
slots.body: Imitation might feel safe, but it erases your unique value. Your audience follows you for your perspective, not a replica.

slots.title: Audit your brand and start fresh
slots.body: Review your content, tighten your visuals, and engage daily. Small consistent changes rebuild your brand faster than you think.
